text: Good evening. I'm looking after my grandson tonight, he's 7, and his temperature is 39 on the ear thermometer. I think I can give him paracetamol but I'm not sure if it's the 6 to 8 years dose or something else, and whether I can give ibuprofen as well? He has a pinkish rash on his chest. I did the glass test and I believe it goes pale when I press, it certainly looks like it does. He's going to the toilet for wees as normal, so no worries there. There's a big bruise on his shin but that's from falling off the climbing frame on Saturday, he told me all about it. Thank you.
